_comment: Pinned toolchain. tools/toolchain.py fetches and checks it; tools/build.py refuses to build with anything else. One LLVM version everywhere: zig 0.16.0 bundles clang 21.1.0, so Windows uses the same LLVM release. The WebKit commit is pinned separately in WEBKIT_REVISION.

perl._comment: Windows only: WebKit's code generators need a native Perl; Git for Windows' MSYS Perl mangles Windows paths (WebCore's IDL generator cannot find EventInit). Only perl/bin goes on PATH, never Strawberry's bundled gcc.
